Use case: stylized-concept. Production ORIGINAL PIXEL ART RPG OVERWORLD WALKING SPRITE ATLAS for Soul of Meal. TRUE crisp chunky pixel art, limited palette, small SNES-era character proportions 2.5 heads tall, top-down 3/4 overhead view to walk on a village map. NO HD chibi painting, NO smooth gradients, NO antialiasing, NO text no labels no lines no scenery. Transparent background. EXACT regular grid: 12 COLUMNS and 7 ROWS, landscape 1536 x 896. Each cell 128x128, one full body centered with feet at y110 in each cell, generous transparent gutter, all sprites constant size (~75px tall). EACH ROW is ONE character, twelve frames: columns1-3 face DOWN (left leg, standing, right leg), cols4-6 face LEFT (left leg,standing,right leg), cols7-9 face RIGHT, cols10-12 face UP (back view). Never alter character identity across views, keep walk step distinct. ROW1: young Vietnamese female adventurer, long dark brown ponytail, teal short scarf, cream shirt, brown crossbody apron/trousers, little boots. ROW2: Lả young Vietnamese woman dark straight shoulder length hair, dark teal long tunic and maroon trousers. ROW3: Chú Tâm middle aged cheerful Vietnamese male merchant short black hair, white rolled sleeve shirt, moss green apron, dark trousers, moustache. ROW4: Bà Sen elderly Vietnamese lady with silver bun, pale cream tunic, brown apron and trousers. ROW5: Bách stout warm brown bearded Vietnamese cook guardian in yellow-brown layered cloth, bronze round shield and wooden ladle. ROW6: Lửa Nhỏ tiny friendly golden orange flame spirit creature (living flame with eyes and small feet), walking bob; no humanoid costume. ROW7: Lam Lam tiny blue serpentine dragon creature, cyan mane, white belly, short legs, gold little horns and curled tail. Rows6/7 same cell but creatures slightly smaller than humans. Match the seven identities with one coherent pixel aesthetic; separated pixels on transparent alpha, no glow haze.
